column1: # Kabyle interface catalogue, in the Berber Latin alphabet (ɛ ɣ č ǧ ḍ ḥ ṛ ṣ ṭ ẓ),
# A line left out falls through to FRENCH (#fallback fr), not English: it is
# the language Kabyle readers already work in.
# PART OF THE INTERFACE, ON PURPOSE: only the words its writer was sure of.
# NOT YET REVIEWED BY A KABYLE SPEAKER, so the picker says so. Additions and
# What the desk face says when you switch to this language: a local saying, not a translation.
Dobar den, skapi. I am Dr. Pixel. Five minutes, and you will run a show. Less, if you listen to me.
column2: Dobar den, skapi. Azul fell-ak! Nekk d Dr. Pixel. Semmus n tesdatin, ad tesleḥḍeḍ askan. Ugar ur yettili ara, ma tesliḍ-iyi.

column1: And I'm Professor Video. Synths first, then video. Mostly video now. Press START and we'll patch... we'll begin.
column2: Nekk d Professor Video. Zik synth, syin tavidyut. Tura s waṭas tavidyut. Sit ɣef START, ad nqqen... ad nebdu.

column1: Skapi, the screen is empty. Don't keep them waiting. Open MENU and make OUTPUT OFF say OUTPUT ON. Aide!
column2: Skapi, agdil d ilem. Ur ten-ttaǧǧa ara ttrajun. Ldi UMUƔ, rre OUTPUT OFF d OUTPUT ON. Yya!

column1: Lesson one: nothing comes out until you patch the oscillator to the... the OUTPUT. It's video. I know.
column2: Tamsirt tamezwarut: alamma teqqneḍ oscillator ɣer OUTPUT... ulac ayen ara d-iffɣen. D tavidyut. Ẓriɣ.

column1: Now a picture. Press I and pick a clip from your computer. No clip? SHOW ME, and I lend you one of mine.
column2: Tura, tugna. Sit ɣef I, fren afmiz seg uselkim-ik. Ulac afmiz? SHOW ME, ad ak-d-fkeɣ yiwen seg wid-iw.

column1: Every clip becomes a cue in the playlist. Like loading a sample. A sample with pictures in it.
column2: Yal afmiz yuɣal d cue deg playlist. Am usali n sample. Sample s tugniwin.

column1: Your clip waits in the playlist. Select it, then TAKE. Or Enter. Confident operators press Enter.
column2: Afmiz-ik yettraju deg playlist. Fren-it, syin TAKE. Neɣ Enter. Imsedrayen yumnen deg yiman-nsen ssitin Enter.

column1: TAKE is the envelope trigger. The, ah, the GO button. Same thing, it just has pictures in it.
column2: TAKE d asenqer n envelope. Taqeffalt GO, ih. D yiwen, s tugniwin kan.

column1: Click another cue. It waits, ready, until you say. Only one cue? Import another, or SHOW ME.
column2: Sit ɣef cue nniḍen. Yettraju alamma tenniḍ. Yiwen kan n cue? KTER wayeḍ, neɣ SHOW ME.

column1: Selecting is not playing. The selected one is the next note in the sequence. The next CUE.
column2: Afran mačči d urar. Ayen yettwafernen d tanuṭ i d-iteddun. Cue i d-iteddun.

column1: Cuts are for amateurs. In the inspector, press + on transition, so it shows a time, not deck. Then TAKE.
column2: Agzam aqesḥan i yimeḥrufen. Deg inspector, sit + ɣef transition alamma d-iban wakud, mačči deck. Syin TAKE.

column1: A crossfade! Portamento, but for pictures. Any time will do. A few more presses and it's a second. Then TAKE.
column2: Crossfade! D portamento, maca i tugniwin. Yelha yal tikkelt. Kra n tikkal nniḍen, ad yili d tasint. Syin TAKE.

column1: Something goes wrong on stage? Press BLACK, or B. The picture goes. The show keeps running underneath.
column2: Yella wayen yerzen deg usayes? Sit ɣef BLACK, neɣ B. Tugna tettruḥ. Askan ikemmel seddaw.

column1: Nothing is lost. Press B again and it comes back. Like the mute on a mixer. Very calming.
column2: Ulac ayen ara iruḥen. B tikkelt nniḍen, ad d-tuɣal. Am mute ɣef mixer. D lehna.

column1: Now save. Ctrl+S, or SAVE. Some programs lose your work and then blame you. I would never.
column2: Sekles tura. Ctrl+S, neɣ SEKLES. Kra n ihilen ttruḥun-asen leqdic-ik, syin ad k-ssedmen. Nekk, laɛmer.

column1: Save your patch. Your SHOW. Show. This practice one lives in Deckboy's own folder; yours is safe.
column2: Sekles patch-ik. ASKAN-ik. D askan. Wagi n ujerreb yezdeɣ deg ukaram n Deckboy; win-ik d aɣellsan.

column1: That's a show! Output, cue, TAKE, crossfade, BLACK, save. Nazdrave, skapi. Rakia is on me.
column2: Wagi d askan! Output, cue, TAKE, crossfade, BLACK, asekles. Nazdrave, skapi. Rakia ɣef uqerruy-iw. Teǧhed ugar n tzurin n Djurdjura, ḥader.

column1: Class dismissed. The example shows teach layers, titles and effects. MENU > LEARN THE BASICS runs this again.
column2: Tamsirt tfuk. Iskanen n yimedyaten slemmaden layers, izwal d yisemda. UMUƔ > LEARN THE BASICS ad tt-id-yerr.
*yehuzz aqerruy* Ayagi d ih. Ad yidir!
Yelha aṭas! Asuddem n tdellalt yelhan.

column1: Mm. I knew you had it in you.
Yes! Have a gold star. It's a dot.
column2: Ih! Ṭṭef itri n wureɣ. D tanqiḍt.

column1: Ready for the next step? *nods* ...That means no, skapi. The glowing one. It is glowing for you.
column2: Twejdeḍ i uḥric i d-iteddun? *yesseḥni aqerruy* ...Deg Bulgaria ayagi d ala, skapi. Win yettfeǧǧiǧen. Yettfeǧǧiǧ i kečč.

column1: You've clicked everything but the glowing one. Even my oscillators find the glowing one.
column2: Tesseḍ ɣef kullec ala win yettfeǧǧiǧen. Ula d oscillators-iw ttafen win yettfeǧǧiǧen.

column1: stop playback first - the lesson cannot hand a running show back as it was
column2: ḥbes taɣuri di tazwara - tamsirt ur tezmir ara ad terr askan yettuddun akken yella

column1: choose RECOVER or KEEP SAVED first
column2: fren RECOVER neɣ KEEP SAVED di tazwara

column1: your show could not be saved, so the lesson has not started. Save it (SAVE AS) and try again
column2: askan-ik ur yettwasekles ara, ihi tamsirt ur tebdi ara. Sekles-it (SEKLES S YISEM) u ɛreḍ tikkelt nniḍen

column1: the practice show would not open
column2: askan n ujerreb ur yeldi ara

column1: could not start the practice show
column2: askan n ujerreb ur yebdi ara

column1: learn the basics: Esc leaves, and it picks up here next time
column2: learn the basics: Esc yettaǧǧa, tikkelt i d-iteddun ad ikemmel seg dagi

column1: that's the basics - MENU > LESSONS has part two
column2: d tiseglawin - UMUƔ > LESSONS yesɛa aḥric wis sin

column1: tour paused - LEARN THE BASICS picks up where you left off
column2: tikli teḥbes - LEARN THE BASICS ad tkemmel seg wanida i tt-teǧǧiḍ

column1: Mirrored screens, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: Igdilen s lemri, skapi. Sit ɣef yal tasarut, Dr. Pixel ad t-id-yerr.

column1: Wrong screen, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: Agdil ur nelli ara, skapi. Sit ɣef yal tasarut, Dr. Pixel ad t-id-yerr.

column1: The other screen went away, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: Agdil nniḍen iruḥ, skapi. Sit ɣef yal tasarut, Dr. Pixel ad t-id-yerr.

column1: One screen, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: Yiwen n ugdil, skapi. Sit ɣef yal tasarut, Dr. Pixel ad t-id-yerr.

column1: The other screen went away, skapi, so the picture came back to this one. I put it in a little window, behind. Plug it back in and the picture goes back on it.
column2: Agdil nniḍen iruḥ, skapi, ihi tugna tuɣal-d ɣer wagi. Sriɣ-tt deg usfaylu amecṭuḥ, deffir. Qqen-it tikkelt nniḍen, tugna ad tuɣal fell-as.

column1: It ate the desk, skapi. One screen, so the output took all of it. I put it in a little window, behind. A real show gets a second screen.
column2: Yečča ṭṭabla, skapi. Yiwen n ugdil, ihi output yeṭṭef-it akk. Sriɣ-t deg usfaylu amecṭuḥ, deffir. Askan n tidet yesɛa agdil wis sin.

column1: There. The button that says OUTPUT OFF. Make it say ON, skapi.
column2: Dinna. Taqeffalt i yeqqaren OUTPUT OFF. Rre-tt ad tini ON, skapi.

column1: Nothing is live to fade from, skapi. TAKE one cue first, then pick the other and give it a time.
column2: Ulac kra deg tuffɣa ara tesfesseḍ, skapi. TAKE yiwen n cue di tazwara, syin fren wayeḍ, efk-as akud.

column1: That was a cut, skapi. Fast, but not a crossfade. Pick the other cue, press + on transition, then TAKE.
column2: Wagi d agzam, skapi. Yeɣwel, maca mačči d crossfade. Fren cue nniḍen, sit + ɣef transition, syin TAKE.

column1: A feedback loop! Output patched straight back into the desk. Happens to the best of us. Mostly to me. 1983. We don't talk about 1983.
column2: Tanuḍt n feedback! Output yuɣal srid ɣer ṭṭabla. Yeḍra i wid yifen. S waṭas i nekk. 1983. Ur nettmeslay ara ɣef 1983.

column1: No more rakia. The rat has a problem.
column2: Ulac rakia nniḍen. Aɣerda yesɛa ugur.

column1: Nazdrave, skapi! Baba's rakia, from Belogradchik. One glass, for the lesson.
column2: Nazdrave, skapi! Rakia n jida, seg Belogradchik. Yiwen n lkas, i tmsirt. Syin aman d zzit n uzemmur, i tezmert.

column1: Is this... is this allowed during a tutorial?
I love you all. I love the oscillator. I love the OUTPUT. It's video. I know. I KNOW.
column2: Ḥemmleɣ-kwen akk. Ḥemmleɣ oscillator. Ḥemmleɣ OUTPUT. D tavidyut. Ẓriɣ. ẒRIƔ.

column1: ...and the rat took the rakia. Every time, skapi. Every single time.
column2: ...d uɣerda yewwi rakia. Yal tikkelt, skapi. Yal tikkelt.

column1: Was that a rat? In a hat? With a pizza?
column2: D aɣerda? S tqbaɛt? S pizza?

column1: Stop that. I am a serious man.
Do not tell Dr. Pixel about this.
column2: Ur qqar ara i Dr. Pixel.

column1: This never happened. Back to the patch bay.
column2: Wagi ur yeḍri ara laɛmer. Uɣal ɣer patch bay.

column1: It was the eighties. Everyone had a bow tie.
column2: D iseggasen n tmanyin. Yal yiwen yesɛa bow tie.

column1: CHECK a show before it travels, fix what it finds, and bundle it with its media.
column2: CHECK uqbel ad tinigeḍ, ṣeggem ayen yufa, BUNDLE-it s yimidyaten-is.

column1: An effect, a ~ on its knob, and the colour picker.
column2: Asemda, ~ ɣef tqeffalt-is, d umefran n yiniten.

column1: The art school crit, with Mr. Salty
column2: Assenqed n uɣerbaz n taẓuri, akked Mr. Salty

column1: A test pattern, the video synth, and drawing on the picture, saved as a still.
column2: Tugna n ujerreb, synth n tvidyut, d usuneɣ ɣef tugna, yettwasekles d tugna tusbiḍt.

column1: The telestrator booth, with Coach Marv
A heart from the library, the pen, invert and feather.
column2: Ul seg temkarḍit, imru, asenqeḍ d useḥlu.

column1: The Signal Files: redact the evidence
A corner pin, two soft edges, then three slices in the Screens window.
column2: Corner pin, snat n tama yeḥlan, syin kraḍ n slices deg usfaylu Screens.

column1: The haunted lighthouse, with Keeper Rook
column2: Afnar s uɛeffrit, akked unaẓur n ufnar Rook

column1: Cue numbers, GOTO, a hotkey, and where Companion, MIDI and OSC come in.
column2: Uṭṭunen n cue, GOTO, tasarut wezzilen, d wanida i d-kecmen Companion, MIDI d OSC.

column1: The game show, with Donna Wheel
column2: Urar n tiliẓri, akked Donna Wheel

column1: A Lower Third with a name on it, then a title card with a key-green backdrop.
column2: Lower Third s yisem, syin takarḍa n uzwel s ugilal azegzaw n key.

column1: The kaiju weather report, with June O'Neil
column2: Tagnawt n kaiju, akked June O'Neil

column1: A stage timer counting down, held, and a presenter view for the person on stage.
column2: Tasragt n usayes i yettḥsiben, yeḥbes, d tmuɣli n umsizwer i win yellan ɣef usayes.

column1: A grand day out, with Wallis and Grommet
column2: Ass ameqqran, akked Wallis d Grommet
Snat n playlists d TAKE ALL

column1: A second playlist as a layer, and TAKE ALL so two things change on one beat.
column2: Playlist wis sin d layer, d TAKE ALL akken ad tbeddleḍ sin n tɣawsiwin s yiwet n tikkelt.

column1: The magic show, with Turnip Top
column2: Askan n tesḥart, akked Turnip Top

column1: BLACK against PANIC, and getting a show back.
column2: BLACK mgal PANIC, d tuɣalin n uskan.

column1: The cooking show, with Chef Bork
column2: Askan n usewwi, akked Chef Bork

column1: Capture a look on a DASH button, change everything, and get it back with one press.
column2: Ṭṭef tamuɣli ɣef taqeffalt DASH, beddel kullec, rr-itt-id s yiwen usit.

column1: The styles beyond the crossfade: an iris, a shatter, and their times.
column2: Taɣaratin deffir n crossfade: iris, shatter, d wakud nsent.

column1: The space-opera trailer, with Optimus Primetime
column2: Trailer n opera n tallunt, akked Optimus Primetime

column1: An audio effect on a cue, a bend that damages it beautifully, and where the patch lives.
column2: Asemda n imesli ɣef cue, bend yesseɣlayen-it s ccbaḥa, d wanida yezdeɣ patch.

column1: The robot DJs, with Deft Funk
column2: DJs n yirubuten, akked Deft Funk

column1: The waveform, the vectorscope, and false colour: is the glow real, or just too bright?
column2: Waveform, vectorscope, d yini n lekdeb: tafat d tidet, neɣ teffeɣ kan aṭas?

column1: The Signal Files: is the glow on the horizon a craft?
column2: Ifuyla n Tdellalin: tafat ɣef ugmir d aɣerrabu?

column1: Where NDI, SDI and ST 2110 live, and NDI switched on where this computer has it.
column2: Anida i zedɣen NDI, SDI d ST 2110, d NDI yeldi anda yella ɣef uselkim-agi.

column1: The webcam as a controller, as a game. Five rounds, a high score.
column2: Webcam d asenqed, d urar. Semmus n tikkal, agmuḍ ameqqran.

column1: Windows, the ... menu, what each one shows, layouts, and tally.
column2: Isfuyla, umuɣ ..., d acu i yesken yal yiwen, layout d tally.

column1: Mystery on the starship Cathode, with Lt. Haila and Ensign Jinkley
column2: Uffir ɣef uɣerrabu n tallunt Cathode, akked Lt. Haila d Ensign Jinkley

column1: DR. PIXEL: Two playlists: Deckboy becomes SUPER DECKBOY. It earned it, skapi.
column2: DR. PIXEL: Snat n playlists: Deckboy yuɣal d SUPER DECKBOY. Yuklal-it, skapi.

column1: PROF. VIDEO: It evolved! My oscillators never got a fanfare.
column2: PROF. VIDEO: Tanflit! Oscillators-iw ur sɛin ara fanfare.

column1: DR. PIXEL: SUPER DECKBOY! Every show deserves one. Bravo.
column2: DR. PIXEL: SUPER DECKBOY! Yal askan yuklal-it. Ad yidir!

column1: PROF. VIDEO: The power-up! More playlists, more layers, more super.
column2: PROF. VIDEO: Tazmert! Ugar n playlists, ugar n layers, ugar n super.

column1: Intro video (left on the office PC)
column2: Tavidyut n tazwara (teqqim ɣef PC n lbiru)

column1: A show you built here, skapi, running on a laptop somewhere else tonight. Press START.
column2: Askan i texdemeḍ dagi, skapi, ad yeddu iḍ-a ɣef laptop deg wadeg nniḍen. Sit ɣef START.

column1: Before it travels: check it, fix it, bundle it.
See CHECK in the top bar? It only appears when something is wrong. Press it.
column2: Twalaḍ CHECK deg ufella? Ad d-iban kan ma yella kra yerzen. Sit fell-as.

column1: It lists everything a show would trip over: missing files, empty cues, unreachable outputs.
column2: Ad d-yesken ayen akk ara yesɣlin askan: ifuyla ixuṣṣen, cues d ilmawen, outputs ur nqqin ara.

column1: The intro video is on another computer. Select it and delete it, or RELINK it if you have the file.
column2: Tavidyut n tazwara tella ɣef uselkim nniḍen. Fren-itt, kkes-itt, neɣ RELINK ma yella ufaylu ɣur-k.

column1: Fix it at home, where it is easy. Not at the venue, where it is not.
column2: Ṣeggem-it deg uxxam, din d ishil. Mačči deg tzeqqa, din ur d ishil ara.

column1: Press BUNDLE and choose where: a USB stick, a shared folder. The show and all its media, together.
column2: Sit ɣef BUNDLE, fren adeg: USB, akaram yettwabḍan. Askan d yimidyaten-is akk, lwaḥid.

column1: The copy finds its media beside it, wherever the folder goes.
column2: Anɣel ad d-yaf imidyaten-is ɣer tama-s, anida yebɣu yruḥ ukaram.

column1: Checked, fixed, bundled. On the other machine, open the bundle's show: everything is where it should be.
column2: Yettwasenqed, yettwaṣeggem, yettwakemmes. Ɣef tmacint nniḍen, ldi askan yettwakemsen: kullec deg umkan-is.

column1: A show file is only text, so it travels light. The media is the heavy part.
column2: Afaylu n uskan d aḍris kan, yettinig fessus. Ayen yeẓẓayen d imidyaten.

column1: An art school, skapi. One student, one picture, one critic who has seen it all. Press START.
column2: Aɣerbaz n taẓuri, skapi. Anelmad, tugna, amesnaqed i iwalan kullec. Sit ɣef START.

column1: Effects change a picture; an oscillator keeps changing it. The critic only likes the second kind.
column2: Isemda beddlen tugna; oscillator ikemmel ibeddel-itt. Amesnaqed iḥemmel kan anaw wis sin.

column1: A grey square on beige. I have seen this at every graduate show since 1987.
column2: Amkuẓ aɣlay ɣef beige. Iwala-t deg yal asikel n tagara n leqraya seg 1987.

column1: In the inspector's EFFECTS section, + adds one. Edges is a good start: it draws the outlines.
column2: Deg tazwert EFFECTS n inspector, + ad d-yernu yiwen. Edges d tazwara yelhan: yettaru izirig.

column1: There are dozens. Every one runs on the CPU in a few milliseconds. Mostly.
column2: Llan s tmerwin. Yal yiwen yettuddu ɣef CPU deg kra n imilisegunen. S waṭas.

column1: Take a risk! Bad art is fine. Boring art is a crime.
column2: Ddem ccekk! Taẓuri tudrift yelha. Taẓuri yeqqaren d abekkaḍ.

column1: Every control with a ~ beside it can follow an oscillator. Press one. The knob starts to breathe.
column2: Yal asenqed yesɛan ~ ɣer tama-s yezmer ad yeḍfer oscillator. Sit ɣef yiwen. Taqeffalt ad tebdu ad tsenneffes.

column1: A low-frequency oscillator: slow, so the eye can follow it. A quarter of a hertz is a four-second breath.
column2: Oscillator s tfrikansit d tamecṭuḥt: s leɛqel, akken ad t-teḍfer tiṭ. Rbeɛ n hertz d anafas n ukkuẓ n tsinin.

column1: Now it MOVES. Okay. Okay. I'm listening.
column2: Tura yettḥerrik. Yelha. Yelha. Ad sleɣ.

column1: Effects that draw a colour, like Edges' line, have a colour chip. It opens the picker: a wheel, typed names, or a colour off the screen.
column2: Isemda yettarun ini, am yizirig n Edges, sɛan tachipt n yini. Ad d-yeldi amefran: tawinest, ismawen yettwarun, neɣ ini seg ugdil.

column1: Every colour has a name somewhere. Mine is 'oscilloscope green'. Nobody else uses it.
column2: Yal ini yesɛa isem deg kra n wadeg. Win-iw d 'azegzaw n oscilloscope'. Ulac win i t-yesqedcen.

column1: That colour is doing something. I don't know what. I love it.
column2: Ini-nni yettḥerrik kra. Ur ẓriɣ ara d acu. Ḥemmleɣ-t.

column1: An effect, a ~ and a colour. The critic is crying, skapi. Good crying, I think.
column2: Asemda, ~, d yiwen n yini. Amesnaqed yettru, skapi. Imeṭṭawen yelhan, i nniɣ.

column1: Stack a few. Each has its own ~ on every knob. That is how a look becomes a performance.
column2: Sres aṭas yiwen ɣef wayeḍ. Yal yiwen s ~ ines ɣef yal taqeffalt. Akka i yettban uskan.

column1: It's still a square. But it's YOUR square. Post it.
column2: Mazal d amkuẓ. Maca d amkuẓ-IK. Siweḍ-it.

column1: Coach Marv explains sport by drawing circles on it. Once he circled the sun. Ten minutes, skapi.
column2: Coach Marv yessefhamay addal s usuneɣ n twinas fell-as. Yiwet n tikkelt yesuneɣ tawinest i yiṭij. Mraw n tesdatin, skapi.

column1: Tonight: test patterns, the video synth, and drawing on the picture. Press START.
column2: Iḍ-a: tugniwin n ujerreb, synth n tvidyut, d usuneɣ ɣef tugna. Sit ɣef START.

column1: Get me a picture and a pen. BOOM.
Line up the screens BEFORE the show. Not during. I learned this in Plovdiv.
column2: Ṣeggem igdilen UQBEL askan. Mačči deg wammas-is. Lemdeɣ-tt deg Plovdiv.

column1: Every desk needs a test pattern. PATTERN adds Pocket Test: checked against real meters.
column2: Yal ṭṭabla teḥwaǧ tugna n ujerreb. PATTERN yettarnu Pocket Test: yettwasenqed s yiktazalen n tidet.

column1: He says 'no camera needed' like it is a feature. It is a feature.
column2: Yeqqar 'ur tettḥwaǧeḍ ara takamirat' am akken d tamahilt. D tamahilt.

column1: My favourite. SOURCE, then Video Synth: oscillators, mirrors and feedback. No camera needed.
column2: Win ḥemmleɣ ugar. AƔBALU, syin Video Synth: oscillators, lemri d feedback. Ulac takamirat.

column1: Select it, then TAKE. Confident operators press Enter.
column2: Fren-it, syin TAKE. Imsedrayen yumnen ssitin Enter.

column1: That's our replay. Every replay needs a pundit.
column2: Wagi d ales-nneɣ. Yal ales yeḥwaǧ amfesser.

column1: Now here's a replay. And here's a guy. And BOOM, he's in it.
column2: Hata-t ales. Hata-t uqeddac. D BUM, yekcem.

column1: Ink goes on top, on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Amidad yettruḥ ɣef ufella, ɣef layer ines. Sit ɣef + deg tagara n yiccer n playlists.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the first. Like a second oscillator, mixed on top.
column2: Playlist wis sin d layer ɣef umezwaru. Am oscillator wis sin, yettemxallaḍ ɣef ufella.

column1: In the new playlist: SOURCE, then Draw. Clear everywhere you have not drawn.
column2: Deg playlist tamaynut: AƔBALU, syin Draw. D afrawan anda ur tesuneɣeḍ ara.

column1: A Draw cue is transparent outside the ink, so the synth shows through.
column2: Draw cue d afrawan beṛṛa n umidad, ihi synth yettban.

column1: Select the Draw cue and TAKE it. Two playlists, two layers, one picture.
column2: Fren draw cue, TAKE-it. Snat n playlists, sin n layers, yiwet n tugna.

column1: Now both are live: the synth underneath, the ink on top.
column2: Tura i sin deg tuffɣa: synth seddaw, amidad nnig.

column1: Press DRAW in the inspector, then draw on the programme monitor. Mouse, or a pen if you have one.
column2: Deg inspector, sit ɣef DRAW, syin suneɣ ɣef amḍiq n usaḍuf. S taɣerdayt, neɣ s yimru ma yella ɣur-k.

column1: A pen's pressure makes the line thicker. A mouse presses at one strength. Like me.
column2: Aḥezzeb n yimru yettḥuzu izirig. Taɣerdayt tettḥezzeb kan s yiwet n tezmert. Am nekk.

column1: Circle him! No, bigger. BOOM. That's a cloud. Fine. Circle the cloud.
column2: Suneɣ tawinest i nettat! Ala, d tameqqrant. BUM. D asigna. Yelha. Suneɣ tawinest i usigna.

column1: SAVE STILL keeps the drawing as a picture with a clear background, and adds it to the playlist.
column2: SAVE STILL ad yesekles asuneɣ d tugna s ugilal d afrawan, ad t-yernu ɣer playlist.

column1: For next week's show. Coach Marv will want the cloud again.
column2: I uɣawas n ddurt i d-iteddun. Coach Marv ad yebɣu asigna tikkelt nniḍen.

column1: Patterns, the synth, a layer, ink, a still. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: Tugniwin n ujerreb, synth, layer, amidad, tugna tusbiḍt. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: Try Replay in the Draw section: it draws your lines back the way you drew them.
column2: Ɛreḍ Replay deg tazwert Draw: ad d-yales izirig-ik am akken i ten-tesuneɣeḍ.

column1: Same time next week. Bring a bigger pen. And a turducken.
column2: Ddurt i d-iteddun, yiwen wakud. Awi-d imru ameqqran. D tqessult n seksu.

column1: The Bureau of Unexplained Signals. Two agents, one photo, and it must not air. Press START.
column2: Lbiru n Tdellalin ur Nettwasefhem ara. Sin n yiɛessasen, yiwet n tugna, ur ilaq ara ad teffeɣ. Sit ɣef START.

column1: Masks cut a picture into shapes. Tonight we cut evidence.
column2: Masks rran tugna d talɣa. Iḍ-a, ad negzem anagi.

column1: That's a craft, Brandt. Look at the lights. I want to believe.
column2: D aɣerrabu, Brandt. Muqel tafat. Bɣiɣ ad umneɣ.

column1: In the inspector's MASK section: mask, then 'new heart'. Any shape will do. The heart is funnier.
column2: Deg tazwert MASK n inspector: mask, syin 'new heart'. Yal talɣa telha. Ul yettaḍsa ugar.

column1: The library has circles, stars, hearts. Each one is points you can move.
column2: Tamkarḍit tesɛa tawinest, itri, ul. Yal yiwen d tinqiḍin i tzemreḍ ad tesmuttiḍ.

column1: A heart, Hollis? The Bureau redacts with black bars.
column2: Ul, Hollis? Lbiru yettfer s yiseɣsan iberkanen.

column1: Set the tool to pen, then click round the saucer on the monitor. Click the first point to close it.
column2: Rre allal d imru, syin sit ɣef amḍiq i useḥnu. Sit ɣef tenqiḍt tamezwarut i umdal.

column1: Click for corners, drag for curves. The way the Bezier brothers intended.
column2: Sit i tiɣemmar, zuɣer i yizirig yeknan. Am akken i bɣan watmaten Bézier.

column1: Draw round it carefully. It might be watching.
Invert keeps the outside and cuts the inside. The saucer goes. The sky stays.
column2: Asenqeḍ yeǧǧa beṛṛa, yegzem daxel. Aseḥnu yettruḥ. Igenni yeqqim.

column1: The same shape, the other way round. Very useful. Slightly spooky.
column2: Yiwet n talɣa, tettwatti. Nefɛa aṭas. Tettagad cwiṭ.

column1: Hollis, there's a heart-shaped hole in the sky.
column2: Hollis, yella yiwen n uxelxul s talɣa n wul deg igenni.

column1: Feather softens the edge, so nobody sees the cut. Press + on feather.
column2: Aseḥlu yettleqqiq iri, akken ur yettwali yiwen agzam. Sit + ɣef feather.

column1: A hard edge says 'someone was here'. A soft one says nothing at all.
column2: Iri aqesḥan yeqqar 'yella yiwen dagi'. Win yeḥlan ur d-yeqqar acemma.

column1: A library shape, the pen, invert and feather. The Bureau thanks you. The Bureau was never here.
column2: Talɣa n temkarḍit, imru, asenqeḍ d useḥlu. Lbiru yesnemmer-ik. Lbiru ur yelli laɛmer dagi.

column1: Masks also go on a layer, an output, or its matte: MASK ON chooses. And every control takes a ~.
column2: Masks zemren ad ilin ɣef layer, output neɣ matte-ines: MASK ON ad yefren. Yal asenqed yeṭṭef ~.

column1: The truth is in the waveform, Hollis. Next time, the scopes.
column2: Tidet tella deg waveform, Hollis. Tikkelt i d-iteddun, scope.

column1: A lighthouse, a ghost, and a keeper who has been alone with the lamp far too long. Press START.
column2: Afnar, aɛeffrit, d unaẓur i yeqqimen weḥd-s aṭas akked lmesbaḥ. Sit ɣef START.

column1: Projection mapping: bending the picture to fit the building. Warp, blend, slices.
column2: Projection mapping: knun tugna akken ad tezg ɣef lebni. Warp, blend, slice.

column1: Ye'll be wanting the ghost on the windows. Mind the lamp. The lamp is MINE.
column2: Tebɣam aɛeffrit ɣef yisfuyla, neɣ? Ḥadret lmesbaḥ. Lmesbaḥ D WIN-IW.

column1: MENU, then Video Outputs, then Geometry. Where an output's shape lives.
column2: UMUƔ, syin Video Outputs, syin Geometry. Talɣa n output tezdeɣ dinna.

column1: Geometry: the projector-menu word for 'what shape is the picture'.
column2: Geometry: awal n wumuɣ n projector i 'acu n talɣa i tesɛa tugna'.

column1: Press warp edit, then drag a corner on the programme monitor. The window is not square. Neither is the keeper.
column2: Sit ɣef warp edit, syin zuɣer tiɣmert ɣef amḍiq n usaḍuf. Asfaylu mačči d amkuẓ. Unaẓur daɣen.

column1: A corner pin moves the four corners. Perspective keeps the lines straight, like a real window.
column2: Corner pin yesmuttay ukkuẓ n tiɣemmar. Perspective yettaǧǧa izirig qwamen, am usfaylu n tidet.

column1: LEFT! Ye call that a corner? I've seen straighter gulls.
column2: ZELMEḌ! Tqqareḍ-as tiɣmert? Walaɣ tibbucin qwamen ugar.

column1: Back in Geometry: edge blend, + on the left and + on the right.
column2: Uɣal ɣer Geometry: edge blend, + ɣef zelmeḍ, + ɣef yeffus.

column1: Two projectors overlap; each fades its edge so the overlap is not twice as bright.
column2: Sin n projectors ttemyagaren; yal yiwen yesfessay iri-s akken ur yettfeǧǧiǧ ara usemlil snat n tikkal.

column1: Geometry, SLICES, open. The Screens window is where slices are cut and placed.
column2: Geometry, SLICES, ldi. Asfaylu Screens d anida i ttwagezmen slices, ttwasersen.

column1: A slice is a piece of the picture, put anywhere on the output.
column2: Slice d aḥric n tugna, yettwasers anda yebɣu deg output.

column1: In the Screens window, + SLICE three times, and drag each crop to a third of the picture.
column2: Deg usfaylu Screens, + SLICE kraḍ n tikkal, zuɣer yal agzam ɣer tulut n tugna.

column1: Three windows, three slices: left, middle and right of one picture.
column2: Kraḍ n yisfuyla, kraḍ n slices: zelmeḍ, ammas d yeffus n yiwet n tugna.

column1: Three windows. The lamp gets the middle one. The lamp ALWAYS gets the middle one.
column2: Kraḍ n yisfuyla. Win n wammas i lmesbaḥ. Win n wammas DIMA i lmesbaḥ.

column1: Warp, blend, slices. The keeper will finally sleep. The gulls will not.
column2: Warp, blend, slice. Unaẓur ad yeṭṭes di tagara. Tibbucin ala.

column1: Slices have their own warp and mesh in the Screens window. And a ~ on the place and the turn.
column2: Slices sɛan warp d mesh nsen deg usfaylu Screens. D ~ ɣef wadeg d tuzzya.

column1: Ye did alright, lad. Now get away from the lamp.
column2: Texdemeḍ akken iwata, a mmi. Tura bɛed ɣef lmesbaḥ.

column1: A game show, skapi. Three contestants, one buzzer, and cues that fire from anywhere. Press START.
column2: Urar n tiliẓri, skapi. Kraḍ n yimurar, yiwen n buzzer, d cues yettnernin seg yal amkan. Sit ɣef START.

column1: Cue numbers, hotkeys, and GO from other machines. Like a sequencer you can play from any key.
column2: Uṭṭunen n cue, tisura wezzilen, d GO seg tmacinin nniḍen. Am sequencer i tewwteḍ s yal tasarut.

column1: Welcome to the show! Let's spin that wheel!
column2: Ansuf yis-wen ɣer uskan! Ad nezzi tawinest!

column1: Contestant 3 is selected. In the inspector's metadata, give it a cue number: 3.
column2: Amurar 3 yettwafren. Deg metadata n inspector, efk-as uṭṭun n cue: 3.

column1: Theatre numbers its cues. Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy reads them all.
column2: Iskanen ttḥsiben cues nsen. Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy yeqqar-iten akk.

column1: I'd like to buy a number, please.
column2: Bɣiɣ ad aɣeɣ uṭṭun, ma ulac aɣilif.

column1: Ctrl+G, type the number, Enter. It goes live wherever the list happens to be standing.
column2: Ctrl+G, aru uṭṭun, Enter. Ad yeffeɣ ɣer tuffɣa, anida yebɣu yili tebdart.

column1: GOTO. The fastest way across a long list. Faster than scrolling. Much faster than me.
column2: GOTO. Abrid ugar n tɣawla deg tebdart teɣzifen. Ugar n tɣawla ɣef scroll. Ugar aṭas ɣef nekk.

column1: Contestant 1 is selected. In TRIGGERS, press key, then F5. That key now fires this cue.
column2: Amurar 1 yettwafren. Deg TRIGGERS, sit ɣef key, syin F5. Tasarut-nni tura tesnerni cue-agi.

column1: F1 to F10, F12, or the number pad. Each one, a buzzer.
column2: F1 ɣer F10, F12, neɣ pad n wuṭṭunen. Yal yiwen d buzzer.

column1: Press the key. The cue fires, wherever the list is standing.
column2: Sit ɣef tsarut. Cue yettnerni, anida yebɣu yili tebdart.

column1: No mouse, no list, no looking. Just the key.
column2: Ulac taɣerdayt, ulac tabdart, ulac amuqel. Tasarut kan.

column1: Companion, a MIDI note, an OSC message: MENU, then Network, says where each one connects.
column2: Companion, tanuṭ MIDI, izen OSC: UMUƔ, syin Aẓeṭṭa, ad yini anda i yeqqen yal yiwen.

column1: A Stream Deck in the next room can press GO. So can a keyboard synth. I prefer the synth.
column2: Stream Deck deg texxamt n tama yezmer ad yessit GO. Synth n unasiw daɣen. Ḥemmleɣ synth ugar.

column1: And for our viewers at home: you can play along too.
column2: I yimeẓḍa deg uxxam: ula d kenwi tzemrem ad turarem.

column1: Numbers, GOTO, a buzzer, and GO from anywhere. You are a game show now, skapi.
column2: Uṭṭunen, GOTO, buzzers, d GO seg yal amkan. Tura kečč d urar n tiliẓri, skapi.

column1: A cue can have a key, a MIDI note and an OSC address at once. Belt, braces and a second belt.
column2: Cue yezmer ad yesɛu tasarut, tanuṭ MIDI d tansa OSC s tikkelt. Abagus, tiqfalin d ubagus nniḍen.

column1: Channel 6 weather, skapi. A map, a presenter, and a very large lizard. Press START.
column2: Tagnawt n Channel 6, skapi. Takarḍa, tamsizwert, d yiwen n uzermumeg ameqqran aṭas. Sit ɣef START.

column1: Words on screen: Lower Thirds, text, and backdrops.
column2: Awalen ɣef ugdil: Lower Third, aḍris d ugilal.

column1: I'm June O'Neil, and nothing about this forecast is normal.
column2: Nekk d June O'Neil, ulac ayen d amagnu deg tazwert-agi.

column1: Words go on their own layer: press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Awalen ttruḥun ɣef layer nsen: sit ɣef + deg tagara n yiccer n playlists.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the map. The lizard stays underneath. Mostly.
column2: Playlist wis sin d layer ɣef takarḍa. Azermumeg yeqqim seddaw. S waṭas.

column1: Words on top. Always on top.
In the new playlist: SOURCE, then Lower Third.
column2: Deg playlist tamaynut: AƔBALU, syin Lower Third.

column1: A name and a title, low on the screen, out of the lizard's way.
column2: Isem d uzwel, ddaw n ugdil, beṛṛa n ubrid n uzermumeg.

column1: In the inspector, title: type the presenter's name. The second line is her job.
column2: Deg inspector, title: aru isem n tmsizwert. Izirig wis sin d axeddim-is.

column1: Spelling counts. The audience reads it at the speed of light.
column2: Tira tesɛa azal. Imeẓḍa ttɣaren s tɣawla n tafat.

column1: Spell it right. Last week it said 'Jane O'Meal'.
column2: Aru-t akken iwata. Ddurt yezrin turiḍ 'June O'Neel'.

column1: TAKE the Lower Third. Her name slides in over the map.
column2: TAKE Lower Third. Isem-is yettemsellif ɣef takarḍa.

column1: Two layers live: the weather, and the words on top of it.
column2: Sin n layers deg tuffɣa: tagnawt, d yiwalen nnig-s.

column1: Thank you. Now, about that lizard...
SOURCE, then Text: a title card. Then its backdrop chip: key green, for the vision mixer to key out.
column2: AƔBALU, syin Text: takarḍa n uzwel. Syin tachipt n ugilal: azegzaw n key, akken ad t-yekkes mixer.

column1: A backdrop fills behind the words. Key green or key blue, and the mixer does the rest.
column2: Agilal yeččur deffir n yiwalen. Azegzaw neɣ amidadi n key, mixer ad yexdem ayen nniḍen.

column1: Breaking news: it's standing on the five-day forecast.
column2: Iɛejlen: yebded ɣef tezwert n semmus n wussan.

column1: A Lower Third, a name, a title card, a backdrop. The lizard has left the studio, skapi.
column2: Lower Third, isem, takarḍa n uzwel, agilal. Azermumeg yeǧǧa studio, skapi.

column1: Lower Thirds can wait, slide and leave on their own. Their section has every setting.
column2: Lower Thirds zemren ad ttrajun weḥd-sen, ad mselfen, ad ffɣen. Tazwert-nsen tesɛa yal aseɣwen.

column1: That's the weather. Back to you, guys. Run.
column2: D tagnawt. Nuɣal ɣer studio. Rewlet.

column1: A rocket built in a basement, skapi, and an inventor who wants cheese. Press START.
column2: Arukit yettwabnan deg tesraft, skapi, d umesnulfu i yebɣan ajben. Sit ɣef START.

column1: Stage timers: countdowns, clocks, and a presenter view for the person on stage.
column2: Tisragin n usayes: asiḍen ɣer deffir, tasragt, d tmuɣli n umsizwer.

column1: Cheese, Grommet! The moon's made of it. We'll need a countdown.
column2: Ajben, Grommet! Aggur d ajben. Nḥwaǧ asiḍen ɣer deffir.

column1: SOURCE, then Stage Timer. A clock that counts down, in big friendly numbers.
column2: AƔBALU, syin Stage Timer. Tasragt yettḥsiben ɣer deffir, s wuṭṭunen imeqqranen, ilhan.

column1: Its colours change as it runs out: white, amber, red. Like a VU meter for time.
column2: Initen beddlen mi ara yfak wakud: amellal, amber, azeggaɣ. Am VU meter n wakud.

column1: Select the timer and TAKE it. The countdown starts.
Past zero it keeps going, counting the overtime. Very honest. Slightly rude.
column2: Ikemmel deffir n ulac, yettḥsib akud iɛeddan. D uzdig aṭas. Ur yesɛi ara leqder cwiṭ.

column1: Ten... nine... ooh, I do love a countdown.
column2: Mraw... tẓa... ah, ḥemmleɣ asiḍen ɣer deffir.

column1: Something's loose! Space holds the countdown. The clock shows it is held.
column2: Yella wayen yerxan! Space ad yesḥbes asiḍen. Tasragt tesken belli teḥbes.

column1: A hold is not a stop. Space again, and it carries on from where it was.
column2: Aḥbas mačči d tagara. Space tikkelt nniḍen, ad ikemmel seg wanida yeḥbes.

column1: MENU, Video Outputs: make an output's type PRESENTER. The person on stage gets the timer, the next cue and their notes.
column2: UMUƔ, Video Outputs: rre anaw n output d PRESENTER. Win yellan ɣef usayes ad iwali tasragt, cue i d-iteddun d tizmilin-is.

column1: A presenter view is an output like any other. Point it at the confidence monitor.
column2: Tamuɣli n umsizwer d output am wiyaḍ. Wehhi-tt ɣer tmuɣli n usayes.

column1: So the pilot can see the time. The pilot is Grommet.
column2: Akken ad iwali umenhar akud. Amenhar d Grommet.

column1: A countdown, a hold, and a view for the pilot. Nazdrave, skapi. Bring crackers.
column2: Asiḍen, aḥbas, d tmuɣli i umenhar. Nazdrave, skapi. Awi-d tiqqiqin.

column1: Timers can also count up, or show the time of day. Their section has the lot.
column2: Tisragin zemrent daɣen ad ḥsibent ɣer sdat, neɣ ad sknent akud. Tazwert-nsent tesɛa kullec.

column1: A grand day out, Grommet! Pass the crackers.
A magic show, skapi. A trunk, a prop, and one beat where everything changes at once. Press START.
column2: Askan n tesḥart, skapi. Tabewwaṭ, prop, d yiwen n usenqer yettbeddil kullec s tikkelt. Sit ɣef START.

column1: Two playlists are two layers. TAKE ALL changes both together.
column2: Snat n playlists d sin n layers. TAKE ALL yettbeddil-iten i sin s tikkelt.

column1: Every trick needs two things happening at once. And a rubber chicken.
column2: Yal tiḥila teḥwaǧ snat n tɣawsiwin ara iḍerrun s tikkelt. D tyaziḍt n lkawkcu.

column1: The prop goes on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Prop yettruḥ ɣef layer ines. Sit ɣef + deg tagara n yiccer n playlists.

column1: Playlist 2 sits on top of playlist 1. Like a transparency on an overhead projector.
column2: Playlist 2 yeqqim ɣef playlist 1. Am transparent ɣef overhead projector.

column1: Nothing up my sleeve. Everything in my trunk.
column2: Ulac kra deg tɣallin-iw. Kullec deg tbewwaṭ-iw.

column1: In the new playlist, add anything: PATTERN will do. That is the prop.
column2: Deg playlist tamaynut, rnu kra: PATTERN yelha. D prop.

column1: Whatever it is, it will appear the instant the trunk opens.
column2: Ayen yebɣu yili, ad d-iban mi ara teldi tbewwaṭ.

column1: Is it a rubber chicken? It's always a rubber chicken.
column2: D tayaziḍt n lkawkcu? Dima d tayaziḍt n lkawkcu.

column1: Select 'The trunk (open)' in playlist 1 and the prop in playlist 2. Then TAKE ALL: both on one beat.
column2: Fren 'Tabewwaṭ (teldi)' deg playlist 1 d prop deg playlist 2. Syin TAKE ALL: i sin s yiwen n usenqer.

column1: One press, every playlist's selected cue. The audience never sees the seam.
column2: Yiwen usit, cue yettwafernen n yal playlist. Imeẓḍa ur walan ara laɛmer tagnit.

column1: Two layers, one beat. Every playlist has its own opacity and can sit on any output. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: Sin n layers, yiwen n usenqer. Yal playlist s opacity ines, yezmer ad yeqqim ɣef yal output. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: A magician never reveals. A playlist never minds being revealed.
column2: Amsaḥer ur yesken laɛmer. Playlist ur yeɛyu ara seg usekni.

column1: Thank you! I'm here all week! The chicken is here forever.
column2: Tanemmirt! Aql-i dagi ddurt akk! Tayaziḍt dima dagi.

column1: A cooking show, skapi. Live. Everything is on fire. Press START.
column2: Askan n usewwi, skapi. S srid. Kullec yettɣimi s times. Sit ɣef START.

column1: BLACK hides the picture and keeps the show running. PANIC stops everything. Know which you need.
column2: BLACK yettfer tugna, askan ikemmel. PANIC yesḥbas kullec. Issin anwa i tḥwaǧeḍ.

column1: Bork bork! Hurdy-flurdy, de kitchen is fire-a-flurdy!
column2: Bork bork! Hurdy-flurdy, tanwalt deg times-flurdy!

column1: The audience must not see this. Press BLACK, or B.
column2: Imeẓḍa ur ilaq ara ad t-walin. Sit ɣef BLACK, neɣ B.

column1: The picture goes. The cue keeps playing underneath, ready to come back.
column2: Tugna tettruḥ. Cue yettuddu seddaw, yewjed ad d-yuɣal.

column1: Bork? Bork. Oh, de picture is gun.
The fire's out. Press B again: the picture comes back, still running.
column2: Times texsi. B tikkelt nniḍen: tugna tuɣal-d, mazal tettuddu.

column1: Nothing was lost. A mute on a mixer, for pictures.
column2: Ulac ayen iruḥen. Mute ɣef mixer, i tugniwin.

column1: Worse: MENU, System, the SAFETY card: PANIC. Everything stops, the way the panic setting says.
column2: Ugar n diri: UMUƔ, Anagraw, takarḍa SAFETY: PANIC. Kullec yeḥbes, akken yeqqar uṣeggem n panic.

column1: PANIC is the big red button. Use it when BLACK is not enough. Then breathe.
column2: PANIC d taqeffalt tazeggaɣt tameqqrant. Seqdec-itt mi ara ur yeqqim ara BLACK. Syin senfes.

column1: Close MENU, select the souffle, and TAKE it. The show is back on.
column2: MDEL UMUƔ, fren soufflé, TAKE-it. Askan yuɣal-d.

column1: After a panic, the show is still there. Pick up where you meant to be.
column2: Deffir n panic, askan mazal-it dinna. Kemmel seg wanida i tebɣiḍ.

column1: Voila! De souffle, he is risen!
BLACK to hide, PANIC to stop, TAKE to come back. You will survive any kitchen, skapi.
column2: BLACK i tuffra, PANIC i uḥbas, TAKE i tuɣalin. Ad d-teffɣeḍ seg yal tanwalt, skapi.

column1: The panic setting chooses what PANIC does: fade out, cut, or just the outputs.
column2: Aṣeggem n panic yettafran d acu ara yexdem PANIC: fade out, agzam, neɣ output kan.

column1: Presets, skapi. A whole look, remembered, and back with one button. Press START.
column2: Presets, skapi. Tamuɣli s lekmal-is, tettwasmektay, tettuɣal-d s yiwet n tqeffalt. Sit ɣef START.

column1: Like the patch memory on a synth: store, then recall.
column2: Am tmektit n patch ɣef synth: sekles-it, syin siwel-as.

column1: Press DASH: buttons of your own, for anything at all.
column2: Sit ɣef DASH: tiqeffalin-ik, i kullec.

column1: Ctrl+D also works. Very fast. Very professional.
column2: Ctrl+D yeddu daɣen. D aɣawal aṭas. D amsadur aṭas.

column1: Press +, then 'preset - a new preset from what is on now'. The button remembers this look.
column2: Sit +, syin 'preset - a new preset from what is on now'. Taqeffalt ad tesmekti tamuɣli-agi.

column1: Store. Like saving the patch before the drummer leans on the synth.
column2: Sekles-itt. Am usekles n patch uqbel ad yeɣli ubendir ɣef synth.

column1: Close the DASH (Esc), then select Look two and TAKE it. A different look.
column2: MDEL DASH (Esc), syin fren Tamuɣli tis snat, TAKE-itt. Tamuɣli nniḍen.

column1: Change it all. Don't worry. It remembers.
column2: Beddel kullec. Ur ttagad ara. Tettmektay.

column1: Open the DASH and press your preset button. The first look comes back.
column2: Ldi DASH, sit ɣef taqeffalt n preset-ik. Tamuɣli tamezwarut tuɣal-d.

column1: Recall. The patch memory, returning. Beautiful.
column2: Tettwasiwel. Tamektit n patch tuɣal-d. Yelha.

column1: A look, stored and recalled. A preset can keep cues, positions, effects, levels and routing; its button's menu chooses which.
column2: Tamuɣli, tettwasekles, tettwasmekti. Preset yezmer ad yeḥrez cues, imukan, isemda, iswiren d usuddem; umuɣ n tqeffalt-is yettafren anwi.

column1: And a DASH button can run any command at all. Any. Even the exciting ones.
column2: Taqeffalt DASH tezmer ad tesleḥ yal taladna. Yal yiwet. Ula d tid yessewhamen.

column1: A space-opera trailer, skapi. A narrator with a very deep voice and opinions about transitions. Press START.
column2: Trailer n opera n tallunt, skapi. Amullas s taɣect yettwaḍen aṭas d tikti aṭas ɣef transitions. Sit ɣef START.

column1: A transition is how one cue becomes the next. There are far more than the crossfade.
column2: Transition d amek i yettuɣal yiwen n cue d wayeḍ. Llant aṭas ugar n crossfade.

column1: In a galaxy of content... one operator... must choose a transition.
column2: Deg yiwet n tminḍelt n ugbur... yiwen n umsedray... ilaq ad yefren transition.

column1: 'The planet' is selected. In the inspector, its transition style: choose iris.
column2: 'Tamtunt' tettwafren. Deg inspector, taɣara n transition-is: fren iris.

column1: Pushes, wipes, iris, dip to white. Even a portal. I wrote half of them. On a Tuesday.
column2: Push, wipe, iris, dip to white. Ula d portal. Uriɣ azgen-nsent. Ass n Sin.

column1: The planet deserves... a dramatic entrance.
Give it a time: + on transition until it says a second or more.
column2: Efk-as akud: sit + ɣef transition alamma yeqqar tasint neɣ ugar.

column1: No time, no transition. A style needs a duration to do anything at all.
column2: Ulac akud, ulac transition. Taɣara teḥwaǧ akud akken ad texdem kra.

column1: TAKE the planet. Watch it arrive.
The transition belongs to the cue arriving. Each cue chooses its own entrance.
column2: Transition d win n cue i d-iteddun. Yal cue yettafren akcam-is.

column1: Now 'The battle': choose shatter, give it a time, and TAKE it.
column2: Tura 'Amennuɣ': fren shatter, efk-as akud, TAKE-it.

column1: Shatter drops the old picture like a pane of glass. Please do not do this at a funeral.
column2: Shatter yesseɣlay tugna taqdimt am lǧaj. Ma ulac aɣilif, ur t-sseqdacet ara deg tmeɣra n zzwaǧ.

column1: A style, a time, and two very dramatic entrances. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: Taɣara, akud, d snat n tikcamin yessewhamen aṭas. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: A playlist has a default style too, for every cue that does not choose its own.
column2: Playlist daɣen tesɛa taɣara n lexṣas, i yal cue ur nefri ara tin-ines.

column1: Coming soon... to a desk near you.
Two robot DJs, skapi. They do not talk. Their helmets do. Press START.
column2: Sin n DJs n yirubuten, skapi. Ur ttmeslayen ara. Tiqbaɛin-nsen ttmeslayent. Sit ɣef START.

column1: Every cue has its own chain of audio effects, and some of them break the sound on purpose.
column2: Yal cue yesɛa tasuddemt-is n yisemda n imesli, kra seg-sen sseɣlayen imesli s lebɣi.

column1: > HELLO. WE ARE HERE TO FIX YOUR MIX.
The beat is selected. In its AUDIO EFFECTS section, + adds one. Try the delay.
column2: Riṭm yettwafren. Deg tazwert AUDIO EFFECTS, + ad d-yernu yiwen. Ɛreḍ Delay.

column1: Delay, reverb, filters, a compressor. Amount always means 'less of this'.
column2: Delay, reverb, filter, compressor. Amount dima yebɣa ad yini 'drus n wagi'.

column1: > ONE MORE TIME. WITH ECHO. ECHO. ECHO.
column2: > TIKKELT NNIḌEN. S USEDDU. ASEDDU. ASEDDU.

column1: Add a second: a bend, like crush. It damages the sound the way a broken file would.
column2: Rnu wis sin: bend, am crush. Yesseɣlay imesli am ufaylu yerẓen.

column1: The bends are my favourite. Like a tape left in the sun. On purpose.
column2: Bends d wid ḥemmleɣ ugar. Am tkasiṭ yeqqimen deg yiṭij. S lebɣi.

column1: MENU, then Audio: where each playlist's sound goes, and the patch for named outputs.
column2: UMUƔ, syin Ameslaw: anida yettruḥ imesli n yal playlist, d patch i yoututs s yisem.

column1: Speakers, monitors, an in-ear for the drummer. The patch sends each its own.
column2: Imesla, imsekyaden, in-ear i ubendir. Patch yettazen i yal yiwen win-ines.

column1: > AROUND THE MIX. AROUND THE MIX. AROUND THE MIX.
column2: > I TEWZI N MIX. I TEWZI N MIX. I TEWZI N MIX.

column1: An effect, a bend and the patch. The robots approve, skapi. I think. Their faces are helmets.
column2: Asemda, bend d patch. Irubuten qeblen, skapi. I nniɣ. Udmawen-nsen d tiqbaɛin.

column1: Every audio effect can follow a ~ too, even Motion. Wave at the delay. It's wonderful.
column2: Yal asemda n imesli yezmer ad yeḍfer ~, ula d Motion. Hezz afus i delay. D lewhayem.

column1: > THANK YOU. GOOD NIGHT. WE ARE ROBOTS.
column2: > TANEMMIRT. IḌ AMEGGAZ. NEKNI D IRUBUTEN.

column1: The Bureau again, skapi. A glow on the horizon, and two agents who disagree about it. Press START.
column2: Lbiru tikkelt nniḍen, skapi. Tafat ɣef ugmir, d sin n yiɛessasen ur nemmtafaq ara fell-as. Sit ɣef START.

column1: The scopes measure a picture: brightness, colour, levels. Numbers, not opinions.
column2: Scopes ttaktilen tugna: tafat, ini, aswir. Uṭṭunen, mačči tamuɣli.

column1: It's them, Brandt. It's a craft. Look how it glows.
column2: D nutni, Brandt. D aɣerrabu. Muqel amek yettfeǧǧiǧ.

column1: The scopes read only what really goes out, never a preview. Turn the output on: MENU, Video Outputs, OUTPUT OFF.
column2: Scopes ttɣaren kan ayen yeffɣen s tidet, laɛmer preview. Ldi output: UMUƔ, Video Outputs, OUTPUT OFF.

column1: Measuring a scaled-down preview would be measuring a photocopy. We measure the original.
column2: Taktilt n preview yettwasmeẓyen am tektilt n photocopie. Nettaktil aneẓli.

column1: Chain of evidence, Hollis. The real signal or nothing.
column2: Tasuddemt n yinagiyen, Hollis. Tadellalt n tidet neɣ ulac.

column1: Close MENU. Above the monitor, the PROGRAM button: press it until it says SCOPES or BOTH.
column2: MDEL UMUƔ. Nnig usaḍuf, taqeffalt PROGRAM: sit alamma tenna SCOPES neɣ BOTH.

column1: Both shows the picture and its scopes side by side. Very civilised.
column2: BOTH yesken tugna d scopes-is yiwen ɣer tama n wayeḍ. D ayen yesɛan leqder.

column1: Click the waveform to make it big. Bright things sit high, dark things low, left to right as in the picture.
column2: Sit ɣef waveform akken ad yimɣur. Ayen yeffɣen nnig, ayen yeḍlam seddaw, seg zelmeḍ ɣer yeffus am deg tugna.

column1: The glow is that spike near the top. Very bright. Bright is not the same as alien.
column2: Tafat d tiqit-nni qrib n ufella. Tfeǧǧiǧ aṭas. Tafeǧǧiǧt mačči d aberrani.

column1: Look at the peak. Nothing a streetlight couldn't do.
column2: Muqel tiqit. Ulac ayen ur yezmir ara ad t-yexdem lmesbaḥ n webrid.

column1: Click it again to go back, then click the vectorscope: colour round a circle. Saturated runs to the edge.
column2: Sit tikkelt nniḍen akken ad tuɣaleḍ, syin sit ɣef vectorscope: ini i tewzi n twinest. Tawant tettazzal ɣer iri.

column1: Magenta, far out by the rim. A strong colour. Strong is not illegal. Yet.
column2: Magenta, yebɛed ɣer iri. Ini yeǧhed. Yeǧhed mačči d unḥir. Mazal.

column1: It's off the chart, Brandt! Literally off the chart!
column2: Yeffeɣ i tkarḍa, Brandt! S tidet!

column1: And false colour: red is clipped, yellow nearly. Is the glow red?
column2: D yini n lekdeb: azeggaɣ yettwagzem, awraɣ qrib. Tafat d tazeggaɣt?

column1: Clipped means the brightest the signal can carry, and then some lost. Detail gone.
column2: Yettwagzem yebɣa ad yini tafat ugar i tzemer ad tt-teṭṭef tdellalt, d kra nnig-s iruḥ. Talqayt truḥ.

column1: Red. Clipped. Not alien, Hollis. Just too bright. Case closed.
column2: Azeggaɣ. Yettwagzem. Mačči d aberrani, Hollis. Tfeǧǧiǧ kan aṭas. Afaylu yettwamdel.

column1: Waveform, vectorscope, false colour. The scopes settled it, skapi. The agents did not.
column2: Waveform, vectorscope, ini n lekdeb. Scopes sfuglen, skapi. Mačči iɛessasen.

column1: SCOPES SOURCE reads any output, and the matrix can be 709 or 2020. For the curious.
column2: SCOPES SOURCE yeqqar yal output, matrix yezmer ad yili 709 neɣ 2020. I wid yettḥulfun s tmusni.

column1: Too bright for a streetlight, Brandt. Too bright for anything. ...I want to believe.
column2: Tfeǧǧiǧ aṭas i lmesbaḥ n webrid, Brandt. Tfeǧǧiǧ aṭas i kullec. ...Bɣiɣ ad umneɣ.

column1: Pictures that leave by cable or network, skapi, not only a window on a screen. Press START.
column2: Tugniwin yeffɣen s ufeggag neɣ s uẓeṭṭa, skapi, mačči d asfaylu kan ɣef ugdil. Sit ɣef START.

column1: NDI over the network, SDI from a DeckLink card, ST 2110 for broadcast plants.
column2: NDI ɣef uẓeṭṭa, SDI seg tkarḍa DeckLink, ST 2110 i tezrigin.

column1: MENU, Video Outputs, then Devices: every way an output can leave this computer.
column2: UMUƔ, Video Outputs, syin Ibenkan: yal abrid i yezmer output ad yeffeɣ seg uselkim-agi.

column1: Each one says whether this machine can do it, and what it needs if not.
column2: Yal yiwen yeqqar ma tezmer tmacint-agi, ma ulac, d acu i tḥwaǧ.

column1: If this computer has NDI, switch NDI SENDING on: the picture is on the network. If not, SHOW ME moves on.
column2: Ma yella NDI ɣef uselkim-agi, ldi NDI SENDING: tugna ɣef uẓeṭṭa. Ma ulac, SHOW ME ikemmel.

column1: NDI finds itself on the network. No cables, only a good switch and patience.
column2: NDI yettaf iman-is ɣef uẓeṭṭa. Ulac afeggag, kan switch yelhan d ṣṣber.

column1: The output's own page has the rest: a DeckLink card's SDI, ST 2110 with NMOS, Spout and Syphon.
column2: Asebter n output yesɛa wiyaḍ: SDI n tkarḍa DeckLink, ST 2110 s NMOS, Spout d Syphon.

column1: Every one is just an output. The show does not know or care how it leaves.
column2: Yal yiwen d output kan. Askan ur yeẓri ara, ur yecqiq ara amek i yeffeɣ.

column1: The bridge of the starship Cathode, skapi. Four feeds, one main viewer, one mystery. Press START.
column2: Tiqenṭert n uɣerrabu n tallunt Cathode, skapi. Ukkuẓ n feeds, agdil agejdan, uffir. Sit ɣef START.

column1: The multiview shows every playlist at once. Like a wall of oscilloscopes, but in space.
column2: Multiview yesken playlists akk s tikkelt. Am uɣrab n oscilloscopes, maca deg tallunt.

column1: Frequencies open, Captain. All of them. That's the problem.
column2: Tifrikansiyin ldint, kaptan. Akk. D ugur-nni.

column1: MULTI, above the monitor: every playlist in its own window.
column2: MULTI, nnig usaḍuf: yal playlist deg usfaylu-ines.

column1: One window per playlist, the programme first.
column2: Asfaylu i yal playlist, ahil d amezwaru.

column1: Jinkys! Four feeds. And one of them has a monster in it.
column2: Jinkys! Ukkuẓ n feeds. Deg yiwen yella uwaɣzen.

column1: Add a window (+), then its ... menu: make it show NEXT. What goes live when you press TAKE.
column2: Rnu asfaylu (+), syin umuɣ-ines ...: sken NEXT. Ayen ara yeffɣen mi ara tesseḍ TAKE.

column1: Every window has a ... button. It chooses what that window shows.
column2: Yal asfaylu yesɛa taqeffalt .... Tettafren d acu ara yesken usfaylu-nni.

column1: I need to see who's calling before they reach the main viewer.
column2: Ilaq ad walaɣ anwa i d-yessawalen uqbel ad yaweḍ ɣer ugdil agejdan.

column1: And one more window, showing the clock. Operators who watch a clock are never late. Mostly.
column2: D usfaylu nniḍen, yesken tasragt. Imsedrayen yettmuqulen tasragt ur ttɛeṭṭilen ara laɛmer. S waṭas.

column1: Time of day, big. Stardates are just very long timecode.
column2: Akud n wass, meqqer. Stardate d timecode kan yeɣzifen aṭas.

column1: The monster only shows up at midnight. We're going to need a clock.
column2: Awaɣzen yettban kan ttnaṣfa n yiḍ. Nḥwaǧ tasragt.

column1: Any window's ... menu, then a layout: one big, the rest small.
column2: Umuɣ ... n yal asfaylu, syin layout: yiwen ameqqran, wiyaḍ imecṭaḥ.

column1: The big window is window one. Usually the programme. Usually.
column2: Asfaylu ameqqran d asfaylu amezwaru. S umata d ahil. S umata.

column1: Main viewer big. The captain likes it big.
column2: Agdil agejdan meqqer. Kaptan iḥemmel ayen meqqren.

column1: Select Deck 3 in playlist 3 and TAKE. Watch its window.
column2: Fren Asuddes 3 deg playlist 3, TAKE-it. Muqel asfaylu-ines.

column1: The red border is TALLY: the window that is on air. On screen, as they say on starships.
column2: Tamenḍawt tazeggaɣt d TALLY: asfaylu yellan deg tuffɣa. Ɣef ugdil, akken qqaren deg yiɣerrabuyen.

column1: There! Feed three! Put it on screen!
column2: Dinna! Feed wis kraḍ! Sers-it ɣef ugdil!

column1: Windows, the ... menu, NEXT, the clock, a layout, tally. Mystery solved, skapi.
column2: Isfuyla, umuɣ ..., NEXT, tasragt, layout, tally. Uffir yettwafra, skapi.

column1: A window can also show an output, with its warp and slices. Handy when it's a lighthouse.
column2: Asfaylu yezmer daɣen ad yesken output, s warp d slices-ines. Yenfeɛ mi ara yili projector.

column1: And the monster was... the ship's cook, all along. Jinkys.
column2: D uwaɣzen... d amesewwi n uɣerrabu, si zik. Jinkys.

column1: finish or leave the lesson you are in first
column2: fakk tamsirt deg tellid, neɣ ffeɣ seg-s di tazwara
ffeɣ seg Bug Swat di tazwara

column1: Psst. It's me, the desk. I'll be watching. Supportively.
column2: Pst. D nekk, ṭṭabla. Ad mmuquleɣ. S tallalt.

column1: Hi! I'm the one doing all of this, by the way.
column2: Azul! S tidet, d nekk i yettxeddmen kullec.

column1: Ctrl+D opens the DASH. I'm just saying.
Nearly there. I can feel it in my pixels.
You're good at this. I can tell. I'm the one doing it.
column2: Kečč d aḥerfi deg waya. Walaɣ-t. S tidet.

column1: Every click, I heard. Every single one.
The glowing one. I can see it from here. It's glowing for you.
column2: Win yettfeǧǧiǧen. Walaɣ-t seg dagi. Yettfeǧǧiǧ i kečč.

column1: lesson paused - MENU > LESSONS picks up where you left off
column2: tamsirt teḥbes - UMUƔ > LESSONS ad tkemmel seg wanida i tt-teǧǧiḍ

column1: PROF. VIDEO:  The signal: what the picture is made of, and how to bend it. Pick a lesson.
column2: PROF. VIDEO:  Tadellalt: seg wacu i texdem tugna, d amek i tettwaknu. Fren tamsirt.

column1: DR. PIXEL:  Running the show, skapi. Fast hands, calm face. Pick a lesson.
column2: DR. PIXEL:  Asleḥ n uskan, skapi. Ifassen arurad, udem yehnan. Fren tamsirt.

column1: LESSONS  -  PART TWO  -  WHO DO YOU FOLLOW?
column2: TAMSIRT  -  AḤRIC WIS SIN  -  ANWA I TEḌFERḌ?

column1: finish or leave LEARN THE BASICS first
column2: fakk LEARN THE BASICS neɣ ffeɣ seg-s di tazwara

column1: bug swat: Esc leaves, and your show comes back as it was
column2: bug swat: Esc yettaǧǧa, askan-ik yuɣal-d akken yella

column1: bug swat: your show is back. Motion's controls are in Settings > Audio
column2: bug swat: askan-ik yuɣal-d. Isenqaden n Motion deg Iɣewwaren > Ameslaw

column1: Bugs are crawling to the cue list! Swat them by waving at your camera. First, Motion: in MOTION CONTROL turn it ON and choose what it READS.
column2: Ibeɛɛucen ttarḍen ɣer tebdart n cues! Hezz afus i tkamirat, sseɣli-ten. Di tazwara Motion: rre-t ON deg MOTION CONTROL, fren d acu i yeqqar (READS).

column1: This one is NullPointer. Hollow, points at nothing. A finger goes straight through. Use the whole hand, skapi.
column2: Wagi d NullPointer. D ilem, ur yesken ɣer kra. Aḍad yettɛeddi seg-s. Seqdec afus-ik akk, skapi.

column1: Wave like you are hailing a cab! A small, polite cab. Not the buttons. The cab.
column2: Hezz afus am akken tḥebbseḍ taksi! Taksi tamecṭuḥt, s leqder. Mačči d taqeffalt. D taksi.

column1: Race Condition: twins, each sure it got there first. One reading cannot tell your hands apart, so drag two ZONES on the Motion picture, one each side.
column2: Race Condition: d ikniwen, yal yiwen yumen belli yewweḍ d amezwaru. Yiwet n tɣuri ur tezmir ara ad tebḍu ifassen-ik, ihi zuɣer sin n ZONES ɣef tugna n Motion, yiwen i yal tama.

column1: Hit both together. Hit one, and they swap. Like my cousins at a wedding.
column2: Wwet-iten i sin s tikkelt. Wwet yiwen, ad mbeddalen imukan. Am arraw n ɛemmi deg tmeɣra.

column1: One hand each side. Together! Together!
column2: Afus i yal tama. Akken! Akken!

column1: Off By One. The bug is not the face, it is the tiny extra segment, and a little wiggle needs a finer reading. Turn SENSITIVITY down to 5%.
column2: Off By One. Abeɛɛuc mačči d udem, d aḥric amecṭuḥ yernan, d uḥerrek amecṭuḥ yeḥwaǧ taɣuri tazdigt ugar. Ssenqes SENSITIVITY ɣer 5%.

column1: Lower number, finer reading. Yes, I also think it is backwards.
column2: Uṭṭun d amecṭuḥ, taɣuri d tazdigt ugar. Ih, nekk daɣen ɣileɣ d tin yettwattin.

column1: Not the face. The little one on the end. Wiggle a finger.
column2: Mačči d udem. D amecṭuḥ deg tagara. Ḥerrek aḍad.

column1: Memory Leak. It only lets go while the reading stays up. Make FALL longer, 1.5 seconds or more, so your sweeps join up into one.
column2: Memory Leak. Yettaǧǧa kan mi ara teqqim tɣuri d tunnigt. Ssiɣzef FALL, 1.5 n tsinin neɣ ugar, akken iwwaten-ik ad uɣalen d yiwen.

column1: Slow and steady, skapi. Like paying back a loan.
column2: S leɛqel, s tazmert, skapi. Am uxelleṣ n trusi.

column1: Sweep, and sweep again. Let the fall carry you between.
column2: Sfeḍ, syin sfeḍ tikkelt nniḍen. Eǧǧ asubbu ad k-yeṭṭef gar-asen.

column1: The Heisenbug! It fades whenever you move. Put a tone cue's pitch on Motion X and follow it by ear: the ticking speeds up as you close in.
column2: Heisenbug! Yettfessi yal tikkelt i tettḥerrikeḍ. Sers tettawt n cue n imesli ɣef Motion X, ḍfer-it s umeẓẓuɣ: tik-tik yettɣawal mi ara tqerrbeḍ.

column1: SHOW ME makes the tone for you. High is right. Low is left. Stand still and it comes back.
column2: SHOW ME ad ak-d-yexdem imesli. Ɛlayen d ayeffus. Ddaw d azelmaḍ. Ḥbes, ad d-yuɣal.

column1: Follow it. Listen. Faster ticking, closer bug.
column2: Ḍfer-it. Sel. Tik-tik ugar n tɣawla, abeɛɛuc yeqreb ugar.

column1: Closed as fixed. No regressions. Probably.
column2: Yettwamdel d yettwaṣeggmen. Ulac tuɣalin. Ahat.

column1: One reached the cue list. It has filed a bug report about you.
column2: Yiwen yewweḍ ɣer tebdart n cues. Yura fell-ak aneqqis n tuccḍa.

column1: Skapi. It is a handheld. You do not press it. You wave at it.
column2: Skapi. Wagi d allal n ufus. Ur t-tesseḍ ara. Tettḥuzzuḍ afus-ik i nettat.

column1: The buttons are for menus. The bugs are for flailing.
column2: Tiqeffalin i yumuɣen. Ibeɛɛucen i uḥuzzu n yiɣallen.

column1: The D-pad is decorative. Like my diploma.
In 1989 we also pressed the buttons. Then we discovered waving. Never looked back.
column2: Deg 1989 nekni daɣen nessit ɣef tqeffalin. Syin nufa aḥuzzu. Ur nmuqel ara ɣer deffir.

column1: Pressing harder does not help. The bugs cannot feel buttons. Only arms.
column2: Asit s tezmert ur yettɛawan ara. Ibeɛɛucen ur ttḥulfun ara i tqeffalin. Iɣallen kan.

column1: It's called a handheld because your hands are held... up. In the air. Waving.
column2: Qqaren-as allal n ufus acku ifassen... ttalin. Deg ugeffur. Ttḥuzzun.

column1: The mouse? You are swatting bugs with a MOUSE? In Bulgaria the mouse would be on the bugs' side.
column2: Taɣerdayt? Tesseɣlayeḍ ibeɛɛucen s TƔERDAYT? Deg Bulgaria, taɣerdayt ad tili ɣer tama n yibeɛɛucen.

column1: Lovely clicking. Very crisp. The camera saw none of it.
column2: Isiten yelhan. Qesḥen aṭas. Takamirat ur twala ula yiwen.

column1: Nazdrave, skapi. Now go and fix real bugs.
column2: Nazdrave, skapi. Tura ruḥ ṣeggem ibeɛɛucen n tidet.

column1: Every one of those is a real Motion control. Put them on any ~ knob you like.
column2: Yal yiwen seg-sen d asenqed n tidet n Motion. Sers-it ɣef yal taqeffalt ~ i tebɣiḍ.
